units: SI: Pa, kg/m^3, m, N; geometry is configured separately in mm
scope: Reference screening database, not measured properties of the user's 4.2 mm wire or 2 mm rope. Temper and actual product must be checked before calibration.

sources.title: Lichen Aluminium: 1100 O Aluminum Circle
sources.note: Page 1: density 2.7 g/cm^3, E 68-70 GPa, Rp0.2 20 MPa. Circle/sheet data extrapolated to a solid round backbone; 69 GPa is the interval midpoint.

sources.title: Copper Development Association: C11000
sources.note: Specific gravity 8.91, tensile modulus 17000 ksi, rounded here to 117 GPa.

sources.title: Alcobra Metals: Copper Product Guide
sources.note: C110 O60 soft/annealed: yield strength 10000 psi, converted to 68.9475729 MPa; reference supplier value, not a measured wire curve.

sources.title: ATI: ATI 302 / 304 / 304L / 305 technical data sheet
sources.note: Page 3: E 200 GPa and density 7.90 g/cm^3. Page 4: annealed 304 minimum 0.2% proof strength 205 MPa for plate/sheet/strip; extrapolated to the round backbone.

sources.title: Mitsubishi Chemical Group: PA6 and PA66 nylons
sources.note: Unfilled PA6 engineering stock: density 1.150 g/cm^3, tensile modulus 3300 MPa. Solid PA6 surrogate only, not an effective stiffness measurement of braided nylon rope.

sources.title: COMSOL: Theory for the Wire Interface
sources.note: Reference for axial force/strain and tension-only cable idealization; this project implements its own discrete model.

sources.title: OpenSees: Elastic-Perfectly Plastic Material
sources.note: Reference constitutive idealization; this project integrates independent uniaxial fibers over a circular cross-section. No OpenSees dependency.

materials.label: Al 1100-O
materials.notes: Lightweight, low reference yield stress; first candidate for easy permanent forming. The actual wire temper may differ from the sheet reference. Hardening and fatigue are not calibrated.

materials.label: Cu C11000-O60
materials.notes: Ductile shape-retaining comparison with substantially greater mass than aluminium. Actual annealing and work hardening affect the response.

materials.label: SS 304 annealed
materials.notes: Higher-stiffness and higher forming-force comparison. Yield value is a sheet/plate specification minimum, not a guaranteed onset for the user's wire. Real 304 work hardens; the perfectly plastic law is a screening approximation.

materials.label: PA6 solid-stock surrogate
materials.label_zh: PA6 實心材料參考值（繩索待校準）
materials.temper: unfilled engineering PA6 reference, not a braid specification
materials.notes: Override effective EA and linear density in rope_config.json for an actual braided rope. No strength rating, creep, moisture dependence, knot efficiency or rope bending rigidity is inferred from these stock-material values.
